WITH large_orders_by_purpose AS (
  SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) as avg_amount 
  FROM `order` 
  WHERE amount >= 2802 
  GROUP BY k_symbol
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_figure
  FROM large_orders_by_purpose
)
SELECT 
  lop.k_symbol, 
  lop.avg_amount,
  lop.avg_amount - oa.overall_figure as exceeds
FROM large_orders_by_purpose lop, overall_average oa
WHERE lop.avg_amount > oa.overall_figure
ORDER BY lop.k_symbol
